blocks.text: MANILA – The Bureau of Immigration (BI) arrested 17 foreign nationals suspected of operating an alleged parcel scam hub in Pasay City following a raid over the weekend. In a news releast, the BI Fugitive Search Unit said it arrested nine Japanese, two Taiwanese, four Chinese and two Indian nationals on Nov. 20. Japanese fugitives Yuto Takahashi, 30, and Matsumoto Shohei, 33, were identified through coordination with Japan’s National Police Agency. The BI said the alleged parcel scam involves the suspects posing as courier firm employees who inform victims that a parcel supposedly linked to them contains illegal items. READ: PH-based […]...
